title: VERIFICATION_ROUTING.json - Phase 6 verification routing decision
description: Written at Phase 6 entry per shared-references/verification-routing.md. Core 3-field contract: route / evidence_type / reason. v6.0 adds na_verdicts: the registered verdict filenames this route + declared skips make Not-Applicable (validate_verdicts.py reports them N/A instead of pending; default sets per route in verification-routing.md section 5). Downstream skills read it, never modify it.

route.description: experiment-first (default) | theory-only (derivational AND no executable computation) | hybrid (explicit declaration)

evidence_type.description: Evidence type from refine-logs/domain-signature.json (e.g. correlational, causal_inference, simulational, empirical, experimental, derivational). Left free-form because domain-signature may carry secondary/union types (e.g. theory+experiment).

reason.description: Why this route was chosen (routing decision is one-shot at Phase 6 entry).

na_verdicts.description: v6.0: registered verdict filenames (per output-protocol.md verdicts/ table) that this run will legitimately never produce. Absent listed files validate as N/A, not pending. Orchestrator writes the route default set (verification-routing.md section 5) at Phase 6 entry and appends later declared skips (e.g. FIGURE_AUDITS.json on a Phase 11 figure skip).
